title: Chờ ánh sáng
about: Round x11, a new direction after the user's five references (analysed for sound and arrangement only, nothing copied), as the user asked ("ok hãy bắt đầu làm"): ambient piano, hopeful and sad at once: G major falling to E minor and C, the piano's soft eighths, a repeated tune, the humming choir and the pad. No drums. An original piece; its tune made up once by the improviser in dark/ambient.py and repeated.
